info.title: yunq API
info.description: Static analysis platform: REST API, OAuth, signed webhooks and operational metrics.

get.summary:
Task queue depth by status plus recent failures, for the ops dashboard
and for diagnosing a stuck or perpetually-failing scan.

200.description: Queue depth by status and recent failures

get.summary: Read the audit trail of gate/profile/permission changes, newest first.

200.description: One page of audit log entries

post.summary:
Authenticate a local user and issue a personal access token that can be
used as a `Bearer` token on subsequent requests.
Register a new local user account.

get.summary: Return the user attached to the current yunq bearer session.
Finish OAuth login and exchange the provider code for a yunq bearer session.
get.description:
Content negotiation:
 - `Accept: application/json` -> JSON body with the bearer session (API clients).
 - anything else (browser top-level navigation) -> 303 redirect to
   `/auth/callback#token=...&returnTo=...` so the SPA can pick up the
   token without it ever leaving the browser.

200.description: OAuth login completed (JSON for API clients)

303.description: Browser redirect to /auth/callback with token in hash fragment

400.description: Provider denied the request or parameters are missing

get.summary: Start an OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow with GitHub or GitLab.

307.description: Redirect to the provider authorization page

post.summary: Create a new personal access token for the authenticated caller.

get.summary: Export ISO 32000-1 Binary PDF Compliance Report (Enterprise Subscription Required).
List the most recently detected security hotspots.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of hotspots to return (default 50, capped at 500).

put.summary: Record a reviewer's verdict on a hotspot.

post.summary:
Runs housekeeping immediately: deletes analyses, issues and hotspots
past each project's effective retention (its own override, else the
instance-wide `YUNQ_DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS` default, if set). Issues/
hotspots saved before a project/analysis could be resolved (or saved
before `0016_issue_hotspot_scoping.sql` existed) carry no `project_id`
and are never matched by this purge, no matter their age. The worker
also runs this on a timer (`YUNQ_HOUSEKEEPING_INTERVAL_HOURS`); this
endpoint is for an on-demand run or an external scheduler. Audit-logged
as `housekeeping.purged`.

get.summary: Search issues with filters and pagination (newest first).

parameters.name: rule
parameters.description: Filter: exact rule id, e.g. owasp:eval-usage.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Filter: substring of the file path.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description:
Comma-separated facets to compute alongside the page:
severity, status, rule (e.g. `facets=severity,rule`).

post.summary:
Apply the same transition to many issues at once. Each issue succeeds or
fails independently — one illegal transition does not abort the batch.
Assign an issue to the AI Remediation Agent to automatically generate a verified fix.
post.description:
Runs the full verify-before-suggest loop: fetches the issue's real source
from GitHub, asks the LLM provider for a fix, applies it in an isolated
in-memory sandbox, and re-runs the analyzer. The proposal is only
returned if the original issue is gone and no new issue was introduced.

200.description: Verified AI Remediation Agent proposal generated

422.description: No verified fix could be produced (source unavailable, or the fix didn't pass re-scan)

502.description: GitHub or LLM provider request failed

get.summary: The recorded workflow history of an issue (audit trail).

post.summary: Apply a workflow transition to an issue.

409.description: Transition not allowed from the current status

get.summary: List analyzed projects.

Read one project's activity log (scan started/succeeded/failed, newest
first). An unknown project key reads as an empty page, not a 404 — same
convention `list_activity` documents at the storage layer.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Filter to one event type, e.g. `scan.failed`.

200.description: One page of activity log entries, newest first

get.summary:
Reads a project's BYOK LLM provider config, if any. The API key is
masked — this endpoint confirms *that* a key is set, not what it is.

404.description: Project has no BYOK override (uses the platform default provider)

502.description: Storage backend unavailable, or YUNQ_SECRETS_KEY misconfigured

put.summary:
Sets (or replaces) a project's BYOK LLM provider config; audit-logged as
`ai_provider.updated`. Requires `AdminAccess` since this handles a
tenant secret, not just a project setting.

200.description: The config that was stored (API key masked)

400.description: Unknown provider, or an empty model/api_key

502.description: Storage backend unavailable, or YUNQ_SECRETS_KEY misconfigured

delete.summary:
Clears a project's BYOK override, reverting it to the platform-wide
default provider; audit-logged as `ai_provider.cleared`.

get.summary:
Generate SVG status badge for a project, reflecting the real outcome of
the last persisted quality gate evaluation (green "passed", red "failed",
grey "no analysis" for a project that hasn't been scanned yet).

post.summary:
Ingest per-line SCM blame (the CLI's `--blame-output` JSON, unmodified)
against a project's most recent analysis.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch of the analysis the blame data attaches to (default "main").

requestBody.description: The CLI's `--blame-output` JSON: file path -> ordered per-line blame

404.description: No analysis exists yet for this project/branch — run a scan first

get.summary:
A project's components (currently: files only — see module docs) with
their latest measures, as of the most recent analysis — mirrors
SonarQube's `api/components/tree` navigation, minus directory nesting.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch the tree is scoped to (default "main").

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort field: `name` or a measure key present on the components, e.g.
`issue_total` (default "name").

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-sensitive substring filter on file path.

200.description: The project's known files with their latest measures

404.description: No analysis exists yet for this project/branch — run a scan first

get.summary:
The most recently persisted coverage summary for a project, if any
report has been ingested yet.

404.description: No coverage report ingested yet for this project

post.summary:
Ingest a coverage report (raw file content as the request body) against
a project's most recent analysis.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Report format: lcov, cobertura, jacoco, llvm-cov, istanbul. Auto-detected from content when omitted.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch of the analysis the coverage report attaches to (default "main").

requestBody.description: Raw coverage report content (LCOV, Cobertura, JaCoCo, llvm-cov or Istanbul)

404.description: No analysis exists yet for this project/branch — run a scan first

get.summary:
Time series of a project's (or one of its files') measures across its
analyses — mirrors SonarQube's `api/measures/search_history`.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch the history is scoped to (default "main").

parameters.name: component
parameters.description:
File path to scope the history to one file's measures instead of
the project as a whole.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description:
Comma-separated metric keys, e.g. `coverage,issue_total` (default:
every metric persisted for that analysis).

200.description: Measure time series, oldest analysis first

put.summary:
Grant (or change) a user's fixed role on a project; audit-logged as
`permission.granted`. No groups, no templates, no SSO — a single role
per (project, user).

delete.summary: Revoke a user's role on a project; audit-logged as `permission.revoked`.

put.summary:
Sets (or clears) a project's analysis-history retention override, in
days; audit-logged as `project.retention_updated`.

get.summary:
Per-line issue and coverage annotations for one file — mirrors
SonarQube's `api/sources/lines`; see module docs for what's deliberately
out of scope (source text, duplication, blame).

parameters.name: file
parameters.description:
Exact file path to annotate (as recorded on `issues.file` / ingested
coverage reports).

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description:
Branch coverage is scoped to (default "main"). Issues are not
branch-scoped in the current schema — see module docs.

200.description: Per-line issue/coverage annotations for the file

put.summary:
Create or update a named quality gate's condition set; audit-logged as
`gate.updated`.

get.summary:
Compares two profiles' effective (inheritance-resolved) rule
activations: which rules are active in one but not the other, and where
a shared rule's severity differs.

200.description: The diff between the two profiles

404.description: One or both profile names don't exist

post.summary:
Restores a profile from a backup produced by
`GET /api/quality-profiles/{name}/backup` (on this instance or another
one). If a profile already exists under the backup's name, the restore
is rejected with `409 Conflict` unless `?force=true`; the backup's
`parent_name`, if set, is resolved against this instance's profiles —
if nothing here has that name, the restored profile ends up parentless
rather than the whole restore failing (so a backup taken on one
instance still restores cleanly on another that never had the parent).
Audit-logged as `profile.restored`.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description:
Overwrite an existing same-named profile instead of rejecting the
restore. Defaults to `false` — restoring never silently clobbers.

400.description: Invalid rule id or severity in the backup

409.description: A profile with this name already exists; retry with force=true

put.summary:
Create or update a named quality profile's rule activations;
audit-logged as `profile.updated`.

get.summary:
Downloads a profile as a portable JSON backup — own activations only
(not inherited ones, same convention as the domain type this mirrors,
`yunq_profiles::ProfileBackup`) plus its parent's name.

post.summary:
Duplicates a profile's effective (inheritance-resolved) rule
activations into a brand-new, standalone profile — no parent link, so
later edits to the source never retroactively change the copy. If a
profile already exists under `new_name`, its activations are replaced
(same "create or update" semantics as `PUT /api/quality-profiles/{name}`
— copy is just that write path with its input read from another
profile instead of the request body); audit-logged as `profile.copied`.

get.summary: The catalog of every rule this server's analyzers ship with.

post.summary: Enqueue a scan job for asynchronous analysis.

get.summary:
Operational snapshot: build version, uptime, DB reachability and a few
cheap counters — everything already available from server state or one
indexed count query each, nothing that scans a table.
Export process, HTTP, OAuth and webhook metrics in Prometheus text format.
List webhook subscriptions without exposing their signing secrets.
Read the bounded delivery-attempt log, including retry and terminal outcomes.

parameters.name: delivery_id
parameters.description: Filter all attempts for one delivery id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum records to return (default 100, capped at 1000).

post.summary: Queue an event for all subscribed webhooks or one selected registration.

get.summary: SCIM 2.0 User Provisioning Endpoint.

ActivationDto.description:
One rule activation as `(rule id, severity)`, both stringified — the
wire shape for a profile's activation list everywhere in this file.

severity.description: One of: info, minor, major, critical, blocker.

verified.description:
Always true: only fixes that survive the generate→sandbox→re-scan→
verdict loop (the target issue is gone and no new issue appeared)
are ever returned by this endpoint.

removed.description: Whether a BYOK override actually existed to remove.

assignee.description: User to assign; null/omitted to unassign.

BlameLineInput.description:
One line's blame as the CLI's `--blame-output` JSON encodes it — field
names match `blame::BlameLine` exactly so that file can be POSTed as-is.

resolution.description: Required when transition is `resolve`: fixed, wont-fix, false-positive.

transition.description: One of: confirm, resolve, reopen, close.

ComponentTreeNodeDto.description:
One node of the nested `tree` view: a directory (`qualifier: "DIR"`,
`children` populated, `measures` empty) or a file (`qualifier: "FIL"`,
`measures` populated, no children) — SonarQube's own DIR/FIL qualifier
vocabulary, so existing SonarQube-shaped tooling recognizes the field.

name.description: Final path segment (directory or file name).

path.description: Full path from the project root.

secret.description: Shared signing secret. It is never returned by the API.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) endpoint that will receive JSON POST requests.

event.description: Event name delivered in the `X-Yunq-Event` header and JSON envelope.

webhook_id.description: Optional registration id. When omitted, all subscribers receive it.

status.description: `pending` (still eligible for retry) or `dead` (retry budget exhausted).

metric.description: Lowercase snake_case metric key, e.g. blocker_issues.

status.description: One of: to-review, acknowledged, fixed, safe.

ImpactDto.description: One MQR software-quality impact, serialized alongside the classic type.

oneOf.description: Present only when the request included a `facets` param.

api_key_last4.description:
Last 4 characters of the configured API key, e.g. `********ab12` —
enough to confirm which key is set without exposing it.

api_key.description:
The project's own API key for this provider. Encrypted at rest;
never returned by `GET`.

base_url.description:
Override the provider's default endpoint (e.g. a self-hosted LiteLLM
proxy, or an Anthropic-compatible gateway). `null` uses the
provider's own default.

component.description:
The project key, or `{project key}:{file path}` when `component`
was given in the request.

date.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the analysis this point belongs to.

return_to.description:
Where the SPA should send the user after sign-in. Server-side
validated; consumers should still treat it as a hint, not a
trusted redirect target.

roles.description:
RBAC roles; see `Role`. Snapshot per session but persistent
across logins via the users store in `OAuthInner`.

severity.description: One of: info, minor, major, critical, blocker.

ProfileBackupDto.description:
Portable backup format: a profile's name, its own (non-inherited)
activations, and its parent's name if it has one. Restoring this same
shape (via `POST /api/quality-profiles/restore`) reconstructs the
profile, resolving the parent by name on whichever instance it's
restored to — deliberately not a foreign-key/id reference, so a backup
downloaded from one yunq instance can be uploaded to another.

new_name.description: Name for the new, standalone copy.

severity_differs.description: Active in both, at different severities.

retention_days.description:
Days to keep this project's analysis history for, or `null` to fall
back to the instance-wide default (`YUNQ_DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS`, if
set — otherwise history is kept forever).

path.description: Path to the checked-out sources, reachable by a worker.

project.description: Project key the scan belongs to.

oneOf.description:
Who last touched this line, from the most recently ingested
`--blame-output`; absent when no blame has ever been ingested for
this file/branch.

coverage_hits.description:
Times this line executed in the most recently ingested coverage
report for this file/branch; absent when that line carries no
coverage instrumentation data (or no report has been ingested at
all — see `coverage_available`).

coverage_available.description:
True once a coverage report has ever been ingested that instrumented
this file — distinguishes "measured, zero hits anywhere" (every
`coverage_hits` is `Some(0)`) from "never measured" (every line's
`coverage_hits` is absent because this is `false`).

lines.description:
Only lines with at least one issue, coverage data point or blame
entry are present — this is an annotation overlay, not the full file
(see module docs on why source text isn't returned).

git_sha.description: `YUNQ_GIT_SHA` if the deploy set it, else "unknown".

pending_scan_jobs.description: Scan jobs still waiting for a worker to claim them.

resolution.description: Required when transition is `resolve`: fixed, wont-fix, false-positive.

transition.description: One of: confirm, resolve, reopen, close.
